text:
maya: quick async — warmup window kicked off for slice-7 canary (1% -> 3% over 30m). will watch liftwatch/signal handshake and post perf / error ticks. :wave:
liam: oncall — I'll be watching p95 & 5xx. alert set if 5xx > 0.5% over 5m. ping me if latency jumps.
sophie: deploy-bot: canary rollout initiated by maya at 08:16 PT — slices: slice-7 -> 1%
alex: what i did: patched the feature-flag to include extra rollout metadata + added trace id to requests so we can tie traces to users. blocker: saw one host with KV-eviction spikes in staging last night, not seen in prod yet. today: queue drain config audit and patch if needed.
maya: noted @alex — thanks. if you see KV eviction spike, shift that host out of the slice via gate and call it out here.
jamie: ops note: traffic shaping rule applied to limit burst concurrency for slice-7 to 120 RPS during warmup. should keep tail variance down.
pranav: analytics: I'll surface top-level health dashboard (latency/5xx/coverage) in ~10m. If anyone wants extra metrics (model token-rate, kv-hit-rate) say now.
alex: please add kv-hit-rate and kernel-queue-length. those two will help confirm whether evictions are material.
liam: quick question — what's the rollback plan if p50 increases > 400ms and 5xx > 0.3% for 10m?
maya: rollback plan: 1) immediate FF cut to previous variant, 2) shift traffic to fallback model variant in region, 3) open incident channel if auto-cut fails. @liam we have an automated FF toggle for step 1.
sophie: deploy-bot: canary ramp to 3% completed at 08:36 PT — monitoring in progress.
jamie: small request from security: add request-id header to logs for SRE correlation — alex can we include that in the trace change?
alex: yep, adding request-id header now. will push env var and small rollout config in 15m.
pranav: dashboard posted: https://redwood.ops/dashboards/slice-7-canary — kv-hit-rate and kernel-queue-length added. so far p95 steady, kv-hit-rate 92%.
liam: p95 currently 180ms, p50 45ms, 5xx 0.06% — looks good so far.
maya: blockers: none immediate. followups: @alex deploy request-id + patch, @pranav please keep rolling 5m window alerts. I'll update this thread at the 30m mark or earlier if anything changes. :thumbsup:
jamie: FYI I'll be on-call for the next 2 hours, DM if you need fast rollback.
alex: pushed request-id change to canary config at 08:50 PT. no errors in the k8s rollout logs.
sophie: small nit — we saw one trace with model timeout 3s, single sample. tracking but not trending.
pranav: will add anomaly detection rule to flag repeated timeouts > 1 per minute.
maya: thanks all — standing down unless we see signal. will post summary after warmup completes. :eyes:
